mentions.name: Storymotion
mentions.description: A tool for creating hand-drawn animated diagrams. It supports exporting animations as 4K 60fps video, using them for presentations, and embedding them as iframes in blog posts or technical docs, combining the experiences of Keynote and Excalidraw.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on https://storymotion.video/

a tool for creating hand-drawn animated diagrams for educational creators or technical writer.
